title: Skins: other looks for Muki as data files
description: Fabio, 2026-11-22: skins are a good idea. Let people give Muki another look (colours, screen and eye shapes, maybe body parts) from a plain data file, so others can contribute skins. Start from character/palette.ts and the face/body parts in draw/parts/. Open questions: what a skin may change (colours only, or shapes too), and how the user picks one (a settings panel, or a setting in plugin options). Keep it original (no Emo / Wall-E / Claude looks). He stays a Desktop mod with no model calls.
